summary.text: Brendan Crighton is a Democratic state senator who has represented the 3rd Essex District since March 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives, representing the 11th Essex District from 2015 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Brendan Crighton won his Senate seat in 2018, taking office on March 7, 2018, after three years in the state House.
In the 2025-2026 session, he chairs the Senate Committee on Juvenile and Emerging Adult Justice and is vice chair of the Personnel and Administration Committee.
He also serves on the Senate Ethics Committee, the Senate Post Audit and Oversight Committee, the Senate Rules Committee, and the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
